nodes.label: PBXFileSystemSynchronizedRootGroup (Xcode folder sync)
nodes.rationale: Xcode's file-system-synchronized groups auto-recognize relocated files on disk, so bulk git mv reorganizations need no pbxproj edits and still build.

nodes.label: On-Device AI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: All ML runs locally via Core ML so journal text never leaves the device, preserving privacy while still enabling pattern discovery.

nodes.label: Force-Directed Knowledge Graph Visualization
nodes.rationale: Physics and clustering run on background threads to hold a 60 FPS UI while rendering cluster islands.

nodes.label: Repository Pattern Architecture
nodes.rationale: Decouples SwiftUI views from the persistence layer, centralizing data access and background refresh synchronization.

nodes.label: AppLinks (privacy policy + support URLs)
nodes.rationale: Placeholder example.com URLs are deliberate rather than guessed; AppLinks.hasUnconfiguredLinks surfaces a DEBUG-only Settings warning until real values are supplied. Unchanged they cause a Guideline 5.1.1 rejection.

nodes.label: Bundle Identifier (GJ.GJournal placeholder)
nodes.rationale: The bundle ID becomes permanent once registered in App Store Connect, so it must be fixed before the first upload, not before release.

nodes.label: App Store Connect IAP Product (com.gjournal.insights)
nodes.rationale: GJournal.storekit is a local test file excluded from the shipping bundle; without a real non-consumable, loadProducts() returns nothing and the paywall degrades to Store Unavailable.

nodes.label: iPad Support Decision (TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY)
nodes.rationale: Setting the family to "1" (iPhone only) is the cheap safe answer for v1.0 — Apple tests on iPad and rejects stretched layouts; iPad can be added later without penalty.

nodes.label: iOS Deployment Target (18.0 vs 17.0)
nodes.rationale: SwiftData shipped in iOS 17 and no API was identified as needing 18.0; staying at 18.0 needlessly excludes the iPhone XR/XS generation.

nodes.label: CrisisDirectory (verified helpline numbers)
nodes.rationale: Only five confidently verified lines are hardcoded; every other region gets web directories only, enforced by testUnknownRegionNeverShowsARegionSpecificNumber, because a renumbered crisis line is the worst possible bug in this app.

nodes.label: Physical-Device Verification Pass
nodes.rationale: Face ID/Touch ID, PBKDF2 350k-iteration main-thread timing, and MetricKit crash diagnostics cannot be proven in the simulator.

nodes.label: No iCloud Sync (JSON export/import only)
nodes.rationale: Keeping backup as local JSON share-sheet export is what keeps the "never leaves your device" claim true.

nodes.label: Same-Day-Only Entry Editing Rule
nodes.rationale: Enforced in LocalJournalRepository.updateBit rather than merely hidden in the UI, so the invariant holds regardless of view code.

nodes.label: PBKDF2 PIN Authentication with Escalating Lockout
nodes.rationale: Plain SHA-256 cannot protect a 4-6 digit PIN keyspace against offline brute force; CommonCrypto CCKeyDerivationPBKDF with ~210k-350k iterations plus a 16-byte salt adds friction, and a Keychain-persisted escalating lockout is the real operational safeguard since no KDF fully secures a trivial keyspace.
nodes.norm_label: pbkdf2 pin authentication with escalating lockout

nodes.label: SchemaVersions / GJournalMigrationPlan
nodes.rationale: The default wipe-store-and-recreate fallback silently destroys a user's entire psychological history on migration failure; it is replaced by StoreRecoveryView offering retry or raw-store export.

nodes.label: Versioned JSON Export/Import
nodes.rationale: Embedding formatVersion/schemaVersion/appVersion gives an independent backup, cross-device portability, and satisfies GDPR data-portability requirements.

nodes.label: HDBSCANClusterer (Swift)
nodes.rationale: DBSCAN's single global epsilon fails on variable-density semantic embeddings; HDBSCAN uses mutual reachability distance, an MST, a condensed tree, and EOM stability extraction. Chosen quality-first (V 0.737 vs DBSCAN 0.477) with the Python harness as correctness oracle and DBSCAN kept as a protocol-level fallback.

nodes.label: Bayesian Soft Assignment of Semantic Noise (GLOSH)
nodes.rationale: Standard HDBSCAN can label 60%+ of high-dimensional points as noise; combining exemplar distance membership with GLOSH outlier membership softly assigns periphery entries so only genuine isolates land in Unsorted.
nodes.norm_label: bayesian soft assignment of semantic noise (glosh)

nodes.label: GGMEstimator (psychological network, Pillar A)
nodes.rationale: Labeled honestly as "shrinkage + thresholded partial correlation network", not EBICglasso: a true graphical lasso in Swift is a 2+ week numerical project with convergence pitfalls and identical insight semantics, which are always associative and never causal.

nodes.label: Ledoit-Wolf Shrinkage
nodes.rationale: When variable count approaches observation count the sample covariance is ill-conditioned; a convex combination with a stable diagonal target yields an invertible matrix whose inverse can be trusted.

nodes.label: Tier 1 FDR-Controlled Association Network
nodes.rationale: At small n, conditional independencies are unstable, so pairwise Spearman/Phi associations are filtered by Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.10 plus an 8-of-10 bootstrap survival rule to prevent a spurious hairball graph.

nodes.label: PersistentHomology (Vietoris-Rips B0/B1, Pillar B)
nodes.rationale: Exact union-find B0 and Z/2 boundary-matrix-reduction B1 for windows of at most 60 points (~1,770 edges / ~34k triangles) is tractable on-device, avoiding a Ripser C++ bridge; validated against giotto-tda/Ripser fixtures.

nodes.label: Semantic Recovery Velocity (SRV)
nodes.rationale: Surfaced as "distance gained from difficult moments" rather than "recovery" to keep wellness framing and avoid clinical claims.

nodes.label: Permutation Null Hypothesis Safeguard (200 shuffles)
nodes.rationale: TDA finds loops in pure noise; shuffling time while preserving spatial covariance builds a null distribution, and insights surface only above the 95th percentile. This gate is the primary defense against algorithmic apophenia and must not be cut for speed.

nodes.label: HybridSearchService (BM25 + vector, RRF k=60)
nodes.rationale: Brute-force SIMD cosine is sub-millisecond at journal scale, so no sqlite-vec dependency is needed; storage stays as SwiftData blobs.

nodes.label: Behavioral Tags Shared Substrate (SchemaV2)
nodes.rationale: Tags are canonicalized by embedding cosine >= 0.85 and only become GGM variables at >=5 occurrences; a Settings management UI mitigates junk-tag risk.

nodes.label: EntitlementManager (StoreKit 2, on-device JWS)
nodes.rationale: A one-time non-consumable with on-device JWS validation needs no server, matching the privacy pitch and the consumer backlash against subscription fatigue.

nodes.label: Freemium Gating of the Three Insight Pillars
nodes.rationale: Journaling, dashboard, calendar, clusters and plain keyword search stay free; only the three insight pillars are paid, and crisis resources are never paywalled.
nodes.norm_label: freemium gating of the three insight pillars

nodes.label: SafetyFilter + CrisisResourcesView
nodes.rationale: A non-blocking, non-moralizing banner that only surfaces external resources keeps the app a supportive tool rather than a clinical intervention; saving is never blocked.

nodes.label: EU MDR Software-as-a-Medical-Device Boundary
nodes.rationale: Automating PHQ-9-style scoring, risk triage, or therapeutic recommendation would trigger Class IIa/IIb obligations under MDR Rule 11; associative-only phrasing and wellness framing keep GJournal a general wellness product.

nodes.label: EU AI Act Article 5(1)(f) / Article 50(3) Position
nodes.rationale: An emotion recognition system requires biometric data under Article 3(39); inferring emotion from written text is not biometric processing, so the workplace/education prohibition does not apply, but Article 50(3) transparency is still met via onboarding disclosure.
nodes.norm_label: eu ai act article 5(1)(f) / article 50(3) position

nodes.label: GoEmotions Classifier Validation and Binarization
nodes.rationale: Classes with per-class F1 below ~0.45 are excluded from network variables, and softmax outputs are binarized at the user's historical median because compositional probabilities force artificial negative correlations between emotion classes.

nodes.label: Dead Model Cleanup (Nomic / MobileBERT removal)
nodes.rationale: Removing the Nomic enum cases would crash on deserializing the stale @AppStorage("embeddingModelChoice") default of nomicMRL, so the binding is deleted entirely in favor of reading EmbeddingModelChoice.current.

nodes.label: Rosebud (generative-AI wellness competitor)
nodes.rationale: Cited as the privacy liability contrast case: journal text is transmitted to third-party LLM providers, which GJournal's on-device architecture entirely avoids.

nodes.label: Babes-Bolyai University DATA Lab Partnership
nodes.rationale: Permutation testing validates internally but only a clinical partnership can link FI/SRV to psychometrics like PHQ-9 and GAD-7.

nodes.label: Accessibility Pass (VoiceOver graph summaries)
nodes.rationale: The edge Canvas itself is made the summary element so it is reachable by touch exploration (refined from a hidden-Canvas plus phantom-element approach after code review); in-graph 7-8pt node glyphs stay fixed size because the spoken summaries compensate.

nodes.label: CrashReporter (MetricKit diagnostics)
nodes.rationale: Made nonisolated because MetricKit delivers on a background queue, and payloads persist unconditionally (rotated, newest 20) because each MXDiagnosticPayload is delivered exactly once and must not be gated on a debug-logging toggle.

nodes.label: UITestSupport launch-argument hooks
nodes.rationale: Deterministic app state (UI_TESTING_STATE_ONBOARDING/LOCKED/DASHBOARD, UI_TESTING_SEED_ENTRIES) makes GJournalUITests reproducible.

nodes.label: TagExtractor / TagProcessor
nodes.rationale: Field-scoped extraction (Event to event tags, Action to action tags) via NLTokenizer plus stopwords, with NLTagger lemmatization only best-effort, because lexicalClass/lemma models are absent on the iOS simulator.

nodes.label: Python Correctness Oracles (hdbscan / ggm / ph)
nodes.rationale: Reimplementing published algorithms in Swift is only defensible if the Swift output is asserted against reference implementations (hdbscan 0.8.44, sklearn Ledoit-Wolf to 1e-9, ripser).

nodes.label: InsightGatingSection (data-volume gates)
nodes.rationale: Gates at 30 entries + 14 days for the Network, 21 + 21 for Trajectory, 10 for Smart Search; progress rings double as an upsell surface.
